lines.E: Another hunter. Try not to die before you pay me.
lines.D: D-rank already. Beastbound gear is open to you now, and my forge is free whenever you bring iron and a beast's trophy. Hale has a job on his board for the first trophy.
lines.C: Heard you picked a Path. Good. Gatewrought needs diamonds and a relic from a D-rank Lord, and Hale has a job for the relic. Bring them to the forge.
lines.B: Lord's hearts make the best steel. Don't tell the Healer I said that. Veilwoven needs Deepglass and amethyst, plus a part from a C-rank Lord, and the forge is ready when you are.
lines.A: People ask me if I forged your gear. I say yes. Don't correct me. Lordscale needs netherite scrap and a part from a B-rank Lord or a deep guardian, and I'll keep the forge hot for it.
lines.S: I'm putting your name on the wall. Don't let it go to your head. Okay, a little. A Sovereign weapon needs starmetal from a fallen star and a part from the Herald or the Court.
lines.SOVEREIGN: I made you a sword. It's not for fighting. It's for hanging over a fireplace. Yours.
